lead: Tesla / TSLA — The Cybertruck lands, believers want a halo
smaller: Affirm / AFRM — Splitting the bill on a record weekend
Eli Lilly / LLY — Mounjaro wins the head-to-head, stock shrugs
S&P 500 ETF / SPY — Chasing a cooling streak into year-end
why_lead: The Cybertruck's arrival is the day's clearest crowd narrative: newly published coverage (n0738 halo effect, n1632, n1620, n1604, n0941) plus a dated pending catalyst, the delivery event this month with only ten trucks (n0853). Tesla 236.08 USD, +13.88% over 20 sessions but only +0.76% over five; attention from enthusiast media and long-range bull framing (n1549, n0742, n0356); analog is the halo-product mechanism Barron's names (n0738); smart money split between US dominance (n0854, n1610) and valuation, discount and Musk-backlash concerns (n0733, n0466, n1474); breaks on panel quality (n0941), ramp, BYD (n0275) and the 207.30 USD 20-session reference.
why_smaller: Affirm: +11.97% to 29.37 USD and +73.48% over 20 sessions on Cyber Monday, after the record online spend (n0132) with BNPL mainstreaming (n0470): a consumer-credit narrative distinct from the 2023-11-27 Amazon lead; holiday-credit and rate-reversal risk (n0153, n0098) supply the break. Last appeared 2023-11-03.

Eli Lilly: newly published head-to-head data (n1623, n0718) and Cramer's weight-loss conviction (n0753) met a 1.59% drop: a sell-the-news material update after the 2023-11-24 Novo lead; Novo's capacity push (n0934) and the 560.23 USD reference supply the break.

SPY: year-end chase as the four-week streak cools (n0155), the FOMO-rally framing (n1046) with BofA bullish calls (n0265, n0665) and the VIX at 12.69 points; central-bank uncertainty and equity-risk-premium doubts (n0151, n0240) supply the break. Distinct from the 2023-11-23 TQQQ leverage item: unlevered index FOMO into year-end.
